attributes.name: Sign of the Thrush
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check. If the check is against an ally, recharge this card instead. 

Discard this card to explore your location. If you encounter an ally, recharge this card instead. 

When you play this card, you may reveal another blessing that has the Sign trait to treat this card as if it has that card's powers.
